title: Solucioning S.A.
description:
This is a small company of 4-5 people, yet it has big clients in the oil production sector.
Unfortunately, the company neglected data security, allowing us to gain access to all their confidential files - projects, documents, blueprints, and so on.
The company has been ignoring us for five days now, and we will soon publish their files. This is a warning. We do not wish to harm anyone, but we are prepared to inflict maximum damage.
Victim website: https://www.solucioning.com/ | Severity: HIGH | Size: 463 GB | Status: selling | $100,000
